main.description: Someone in a performer's, party's or venue's space, keyed by their DID. Written only by the Local Network root account, which makes them a member of the space: a reader, and a writer when one of their capabilities writes. Deleting it takes them out.

hidden.description: Whether they keep out of public view. Only the people in the space and staff see them.

via.description: created: they started it. invite: they accepted an invite. link: they joined with an invite link. request: their request to join was approved. staff: staff added them.

source.description: The invite, invite link or request they came in through.
